text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: Polaris dedicated pool goes live WED 06:00 UTC. Were calling this a "gentle surge" cutover. Goals: verify quota, run staged loadtest, confirm autoscale behavior, capture any customer experience issues, and log feedback for renewal playbook. Who owns coordination during the 06:00-08:00 UTC window?

Sam (Infra): Ill coordinate infra handoff and reservations. Pool details: pool-id=polaris-ded-03, template=reserved-a100v4-highmem. Reserved slots=8, burst=+2. Ill attach reservation ticket and slot manifest to the customer record.

Liam (SE): Ill own the workload script and can run the staged load. Plan: stage1 10rps 10m (smoke), stage2 50rps 20m (canary), stage3 200rps 30m (stress), then steady-state. Need API key with canary role and KMS unseal window 06:00-07:00.

Priya (SRE): Autoscale suggestion: min_replicas=3, target_util=55%, max_replicas=14, scale_up_cooldown=90s, scale_down_cooldown=300s. Enable metric "queue_latency" as secondary signal and set p95 latency alert to 350ms.

Maya (CS): Customer asked for one-time billing buffer for warmup token burn. Ill note it in the contract addendum. Also capture feedback points: model quality regression, latency spikes, and any auth / key issues.

Sam (Infra): Warmup command (agent will prime caches and KV):

Sam (Infra): ```
redwoodctl reserve create --pool polaris-ded-03 --slots 8 --duration 4h --note "polaris-gentle-surge"
redwoodctl capacity warm --pool polaris-ded-03 --profile warm-cache --concurrency 4
```

ops-bot: Scheduled load job id=1769987654-load by @Liam for 2026-04-01T06:10:00Z. Logs will post to this thread.

Liam (SE): Smoke curl I'll use (will swap real token at runtime):

Liam (SE): ```
curl -X POST https://polaris.api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer CANARY_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input": "smoke test"}'
```

Priya (SRE): Fallback plan: route 0% -> 30% to hosted-quantized fallback if errors > 1% for > 2m during canary. Add a circuit-breaker that throttles new sessions if queue_length > 2000. Also enable rapid rollback script.

Maya (CS): Can someone own customer communication during the window? I'll prepare the status blurb but need someone to send near real-time updates. Also please flag any UX regressions for product to triage.

Sam (Infra): Ill post infra status updates here and add links to reservation ticket + runbook. Alerts: quota@85% -> #customer-success, #eng-oncall; latency-p95@350ms -> #eng-sre.

Priya (SRE): Ill watch metrics and post 5-min snapshots. Targets to call OK: p95 < 300ms, error_rate < 0.75%, sustained queue < 1200. If we breach, we roll to fallback.

Liam (SE): After the run Ill upload a short summary (latency, errors, token burn) and a sample prompt set we used for quality checks. Please remind me to include customer feedback capture form link.

Maya (CS): Perfect. Quick checklist before 06:00: 1) KMS unseal window confirmed (Sam) 2) API keys distributed to canary role (Liam) 3) Reservation created (Sam) 4) Runbook + rollback snippet in ticket (Priya) 5) Billing buffer noted (Maya). DM me if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
